note: HS mismatch: declared 843149 (earthmoving/construction machinery parts) is not the actual traded code. Customs rows show HS 84099114 (piston assemblies), 84099113 (piston rings), 84099911 (valve seat exhaust) — i.e. Chapter 84 internal-combustion engine parts, not 8431. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: company stays in the base, HS should be corrected to 840991 (piston assemblies/rings) as the primary code. Industry claim 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is also inaccurate — the company is an automotive components manufacturer (pistons, piston rings, valve seats), subsidiary of Tenneco/Federal-Mogul. Role: manufacturer (not a trader). Export shipments are real and recent (Feb 2026), destinations include USA, Germany, UK, Sri Lanka, China; several flows are intra-group (Federal-Mogul Motorparts LLC, Federal-Mogul Burscheid GmbH) plus JCB Power Systems.
